```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

depression <- read_delim("C:/Users/redin/OneDrive/Desktop/⭐SCHOOL⭐/INFO201/Exercise/Depression Professional Dataset.csv")
names(depression)
head(depression)
```

```{r satisfaction-by-pressure}
names(depression)[names(depression) == "Work Pressure"] <- "WorkPressure"
names(depression)[names(depression) == "Job Satisfaction"] <- "JobSatisfaction"

summary_data <- depression %>%
  group_by(WorkPressure) %>%
  summarize(AverageSatisfaction = mean(JobSatisfaction, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = as.factor(WorkPressure), y = AverageSatisfaction)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "pink") +
  labs(
    title = "Average Job Satisfaction by Work Pressure Level",
    x = "Work Pressure Level",
    y = "Average Job Satisfaction"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(2.8, 3.2)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(AverageSatisfaction, 2)), vjust = -0.5) +
  theme_minimal()
```
